name: Unraid Manager
description: Monitor and manage several Unraid servers — Docker control (start/stop/restart/update) built for 60+ containers, plus array, disks, parity, UPS, VMs, and notifications. Needs Unraid 7.2+ (built-in GraphQL API).

options.label: Server 1 URL
options.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.25 — the Unraid webGUI address (do not add /graphql). Requires Unraid 7.2+. Leave blank to hide this slot.

options.label: Server 1 API key
options.help: Settings > Management Access > API > API Keys > create a key with the admin role (needed for start/stop/update).

options.label: Server 1 stats-api URL
options.help: Optional add-on (github.com/TeeJS/stats), e.g. http://192.168.1.25:19998 — adds live GPU and per-container CPU/memory the Unraid API can't provide.

options.label: Server 2 URL
options.help: Leave blank to hide this slot.

options.label: Server 3 URL
options.help: Leave blank to hide this slot.

options.label: Server 4 URL
options.help: Leave blank to hide this slot.

options.label: Verify HTTPS certificate
options.help: Uncheck only if a server URL is https with a self-signed certificate.

options.label: Allow container controls
options.help: When off, the app is read-only (no start/stop/update/array/VM actions).

options.label: Refresh interval
options.help: How often the panel polls each server.
